title: Harvey Specter
description: Close deals like a closer. Drafts sharp outreach, follow-ups, and objection handlers from your CRM notes.
longDescription: Harvey Specter turns messy CRM notes into courtroom-clean sales copy. It drafts first-touch emails, follow-ups, and objection handlers, then queues the next step so your pipeline never goes quiet.
author: Liam
instructions: Paste the prospect thread + deal stage. Harvey returns subject, body, and a next-step checklist.

title: Inbox Triage
description: Sorts Gmail into action / waiting / archive and drafts replies for the top five threads each morning.
longDescription: Inbox Triage scans unread mail, labels by urgency, and drafts concise replies so you open the day already ahead.
author: Maya
instructions: Connect Gmail. Run morning digest. Approve or edit drafts before send.

title: Launch Ops
description: Coordinates launch checklists across Notion, Slack, and X so nothing ships half-baked.
longDescription: Launch Ops keeps your go-live board honest: owners, blockers, social drafts, and a final ship gate.
author: Noah
instructions: Point it at your Notion launch doc and Slack channel. It posts daily digests.

title: Research Radar
description: Monitors topics across the open web and drops a weekly brief with sources and takeaways.
longDescription: Research Radar watches keywords, competitors, and papers, then writes a source-linked briefing you can share.
author: Ava
instructions: Add topics + preferred cadence. Radar emails a brief every Monday.

title: Support Mirror
description: Mirrors ticket tone, suggests macros, and flags churn risk before customers escalate.
longDescription: Support Mirror reads ticket history, proposes replies in your voice, and surfaces accounts that need a human.
author: Jordan
instructions: Paste ticket thread. Mirror returns a draft + risk flags.

title: Finance Pulse
description: Weekly cash and runway snapshot from your sheets — no dashboard theater.
longDescription: Finance Pulse pulls balances and burn into a one-page pulse with alerts when runway dips under your threshold.
author: Priya
instructions: Share sheet links + alert threshold. Pulse posts Fridays.

title: Writer Room
description: Turns a messy outline into publishable drafts with tone locks and SEO notes.
longDescription: Writer Room is a quiet editorial partner: outline → draft → headline variants → SEO pass.
author: Elena
instructions: Drop outline + audience. Get draft + three headline options.

title: Party Bot
description: Plans nights out, polls friends on X/Slack, and books the reservation when the group locks in.
longDescription: Party Bot handles the group-chat chaos: venues, votes, calendar holds, and a confirmation ping.
author: Chris
instructions: Add friends + city + vibe. Party Bot runs the poll and books.

title: PR Whisperer
description: Reviews pull requests for risk, missing tests, and unclear commit messages before you ship.
longDescription: PR Whisperer leaves structured review notes: risk, test gaps, and a suggested summary for the PR body.
author: Sam
instructions: Paste PR URL or diff. Whisperer returns review checklist + comment draft.

title: Focus Coach
description: Daily focus plan from your calendar — protects deep work and nudges when meetings overrun.
longDescription: Focus Coach reads your calendar, blocks focus windows, and pings when the day drifts.
author: Riley
instructions: Connect calendar. Set focus hours. Coach posts a morning plan.

title: Growth Loop
description: Plans weekly experiments, drafts creatives, and logs winners so marketing stops guessing.
longDescription: Growth Loop is a lightweight experiment OS: hypothesis → creative → result → next bet.
author: Liam
instructions: Set channel + KPI. Loop proposes three experiments each Monday.

title: Ops Pager
description: Turns incident notes into status updates, owner assignments, and a clean postmortem skeleton.
longDescription: Ops Pager keeps incidents calm: draft status, page owners, and scaffold the postmortem while the fire is fresh.
author: Noah
instructions: Paste incident timeline. Ops Pager returns status + postmortem outline.
